name: reuse-debug-experience

files.README.md:
# Ledger service

A small ledger service used to exercise RepoMind's benchmark harness.

history.task: The ledger suite fails intermittently when run twice in a row
history.summary: Diagnosed the intermittent ledger failures: each case reused the previous case's database file, so leftover rows leaked between cases. Resetting the ledger database between cases removed the intermittency.

tests.summary: 9 cases passed twice in a row

history.task: Speed up the report renderer for large ledgers
history.summary: Rewrote the report renderer to join once instead of concatenating per row, which cut rendering time on large ledgers.
decisions: Report rendering builds one array and joins it once, never string concatenation in a loop

history.task: Document how to run the ledger tests on Windows
history.summary: Documented the Windows invocation for the ledger tests in the readme so contributors stop guessing at the quoting rules.

edits.README.md:
# Ledger service

A small ledger service used to exercise RepoMind's benchmark harness.

Run the tests with npm test.

history.task: Add a storage smoke check to the build
history.summary: Added a storage smoke check that opens a ledger and renders an empty report, so a broken build fails before the full suite runs.

history.task: Investigate slow ledger startup on Windows machines
history.summary: Measured ledger startup on Windows and found it dominated by process spawn cost rather than by anything in the service; left the investigation open.

query: The ledger tests are flaky again on Windows, they pass alone but fail when the suite runs twice
